input.quote: 13.1 Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: The grant clause meets the preferred position in full. Section 13.1 extends the subscription right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (no notice condition needed); Section 13.2 gives Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence for delivered/embedded Vendor Technology, including contractor support rights; and Section 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under the Section 24 assignment right and bars revocation or suspension except for a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a cure opportunity. Nothing makes the licence revocable at Vendor's discretion. Noted but not flagged here: Section 14.2 describes the Deliverable licence as "revocable, non-transferable" and term-limited, which sits awkwardly against Sections 13.2–13.3 and 14.3; that point concerns Deliverable ownership and is addressed under the IP rule rather than duplicated here.
